speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your medical history in detail, specifically regarding when you first noticed the easy bruising and if you have ever been diagnosed with a bleeding disorder or experienced excessive bleeding during surgeries.

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia B (Factor IX Deficiency)

Thank you for the history. Your uncle's history of joint swelling (hemarthrosis) alongside your own bleeding suggests a congenital factor deficiency rather than a platelet disorder. REQUEST TEST: Coagulation Panel (PT, PTT, Factor Activity Levels) AND REQUEST IMAGES: MRI of affected joints to assess for hemarthrosis.
